name: Imperium Crown Limited
summary: Imperium Crown Limited operates as a property investment, development, and management company in China. The company engages in the development of Wonder Stone Park, a tourist attraction and mixed-use development project with a theme park featuring rides and attractions. It also operates a hotel under the Inzone brand. The company was formerly known as Communication Design International Limited and changed its name to Imperium Crown Limited in June 2015. Imperium Crown Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Singapore.
